transcript.text: Of course what Liv's saying, I've taken to heart. Her calling me talentless and useless and a placeholder champion.
I know she's not the only person saying that. I see it. I read it. I hear it. And it hurts, Nick, because sometimes I tell myself that too.
I show up to work and I fight the urge to doubt myself every single time I'm here. And I know that a WWE champion shouldn't admit that.
But it's true. I wake up every morning and I look at this and I question, do I deserve this?
What are you saying, Chelsea? Listen to these people. You are the WWE Women's Champion. Yes, you deserve it. Yes, your championship material.
